english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for someone or something stylish and appealing.
Use 有型 when fashionable mainly means stylish or cool-looking, especially of a person, outfit, or object.
Use this for a stylish, visually striking look when “classy” leans toward cool and fashionable rather than tasteful.
Use this when the impressive quality is mainly someone's stylish, striking, or charismatic appearance.
Use 有型 for someone or something that looks stylish, fashionable, or impressively well put together.
Use this for someone or something that is stylish, fashionable, or glamorous in appearance.
